## Catálogo Interactivo

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(reactable)
library(reactablefmtr)

# Define the function to create the interactive table
tbl_movies_found <- function(movies_found) {
  movies_found |>
    dplyr::select(Title, Year, Plot, Poster, Genre) |>
    reactable(
      theme = fivethirtyeight(centered = TRUE),
      striped = TRUE,
      pagination = TRUE,
      searchable = TRUE,
      defaultColDef = colDef(align = 'center'),
      columns = list(
        Poster = colDef(
          name = 'Poster',
          maxWidth = 200,
          cell = embed_img(height = 200, width = 150)
        ),
        Title = colDef(maxWidth = 150, name = 'Pelicula'),
        Year = colDef(maxWidth = 70, name = 'Año'),
        Plot = colDef(minWidth = 150, name = 'Trama'),
        Genre = colDef(minWidth = 100, name = "Generos")
      )
    )
}

# Load the data and render the table
movies_data <- readr::read_csv("data/final_results/all_movies.csv") |>
  mutate(
    Poster = if_else(is.na(Poster) | Poster == "N/A", "https://i.imgur.com/Ngnm5v6.png", Poster)
  )

tbl_movies_found(movies_data)
```
